description: Batch07: 80 original first-pass A2-C1 drafts; independent dictionary sense, Myanmar editor, grammar, CEFR and George/Emma listening all pending. C1 tier is provisional and may require reclassification.

burmese_review.task: Independent Burmese editor to check naturalness, meaning and register for this exact sense.

example_review.task: Independently check original sentence for grammar, collocation and intended sense.

cefr_review.task: Verify CEFR of exact sense and POS, not word frequency; reclassify or quarantine unsupported tier.

audio_review.task: After editorial approval, generate and listen to George and Emma word/example recordings including physical iPhone Safari.
